translations.web: He has shown his people the power of his works, in giving them the heritage of the nations.
translations.bsb: He has shown His people the power of His works by giving them the inheritance of the nations.
translations.kjv: He hath shewed his people the power of his works, that he may give them the heritage of the heathen.
